$Comment: Hallow's Eve, this pack's yearly event. The file name is the event id: every gate, spawn rule
and find in the pack names it Hallows_Eve. Both days of the Window are in it, counted in UTC
because no Clock is written, so the event runs from the first moment of October 1st to the last
moment of November 3rd, every year from FirstYear on.
Content that must vanish while the event is not running gates on ziggfreedcommon:feature with
Param Hallows_Eve_Live and Min 1 at the top of its Requires. A roll or a lock reads
Presentation names the event wherever events are listed, with the Jack Lantern as its picture.
Herald is the banner: Start shows once to each player, the first time they are on the server
during a run; End shows to everyone online when a run ends by its dates or by a command, and
never when the event is switched off.
A server owner switches the event off, or moves its days, in mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json
without touching this file. /zigcalendar status Hallows_Eve shows what the server reads.
